profile.headline:
Looking for Remote positions.
Mainframe Programmer with extensive and diverse experience.  Programming knowledge includes but not limited to COBOL, CICS XGEN DB2, DMSII  Expediter Micro Focus IBM and Unisys A Series.
profile.summary:
•Analyzed business requirements and technical specification documents to develop the test cases and scenarios. 
•Worked on Human Resources and Payroll System conversion. 
•Data Mapping.
•FTP files to Access Database
••Wrote and implemented the new SMPT e-mail process by  IBM
•Responsible for the conversion of Reports using COBOL to create VSAM flat files to be FTP to the Access database. 
•Maintained COBOL and CICS programs.
•Modified programs, processes, and applications post implementation
•Performed database maintenance, expansions to increase field sizes, removed redundant data fields, and added needed fields. 
•Served as a Team Leader for the rewrite of the Detroit Police Departments online and batch systems. 
•Designed and developed user online screens using XGEN and COBOL.
•Developed and helped design ECATTS system using DreamWeaver, Crystal Reports and COBOL for the City of Detroit and 36th District Court of Michigan. 
•Created batch programs and Wfls (JCL) for FTP to upload the files to the client server side 
•Served as a System Analyst of the Insurance system for car sales. 
•Worked on designing the database for the Insurance for rental of cars from dealers. 
•,Beta testing of new products with QA and Development staff(Expeditior)
•Developed and designed an online CICS system that read 13 files to reflect the current status of an Insured Policy (I.E. Date Policy Issued, Cancellation Date, Amount of policy, and Type of Insurance). 
•Developed and designed an online Accounts Receivable system. 
•Performed program maintenance on various manufacturing and financial systems. 
•Wrote programs that provided estimates of when the steel processing would be completed and shipped to the customer. 
•Participated in DOS to OS conversion.
•Performed RPG to COBOL conversion also FORTRAN to COBOL conversion.

positions.title: Software Developer (COBOL)
positions.description:
•	Maintenance and operations support, including batch cycle support for existing COBOL applications in a midrange environment
•	Creation of programing documentation
•	Developer for USAF suite of financial systems including General Accounting and Finance System (GAFS)
•	Develop design and test artifacts to resolve DRs and provided technical solutions for SCRs
•	 Perform Coding, Unit Test, and Continuous Integration of software components
•	SME for conversion of Green Screens to GUI 
Environment: UNISYS OS2200, COBOL 74, COBOL 85, Louis, Shared File System

positions.title: Technology Lead
positions.description:
•	Maintenance and operations support, including batch cycle support for existing XGEN / Micro Focus COBOL applications in a midrange environment
•	Creation of programing documentation
•	Develop program to change addresses to adapt to USPS
•	Develop programs to update SQL database
•	Updated programs to change Letters titles and headings 
•	Created files to upload to Data Warehouse   
Environment: UNISYS MAINFRAME, Info Connect, CANDE, WFL, XGEN, DMSII Database, Work Bench, COBOL, BLSOURCE. IBM Mainframe, COBOL, CICS JCL

positions.title: COBOL Programmer
positions.description:
•	Maintenance and operations support, including batch cycle support for existing XGEN / Micro Focus COBOL applications in a midrange environment
•	Creation of testing scripts and testing of applications
•	Development of application deployment plans
•	Created programing documentation(steps needed to run processes) 
•	Updated 3 SQL databases, converting Social Security Numbers 
•	Monitoring, management and troubleshooting of FTP interface processes
•	Conversion of databases from SQL 2000 or later to SQL 2012
Environment:, Micro Focus COBOL, Windows Command script, Clear Case for code versioning, XIDE, SQL Database

positions.title: Senior Support Analyst
positions.description:
•	Analyze business requirements and technical specification documents to develop COBOL 85 updates.
•	Maintenance of COBOL85  Batch programs using ECLIPSE and Unisys Mainframe
•	Maintenance of COMS programs using ECLIPSE and Blue Bridge
Environment: UNISYS MAINFRAME, CANDE, WFL, ECLIPSE, MICRO FOCUS, VISUAL STUDIO, VSAM, XGEN, Bluebridge, DMSII Database, COBOL85

company.name: Computer Task Group(Blue Cross Blue Shield Fargo ND)

positions.title: Foritira(Fidelity InvestmenT)
positions.description:
On assignment at Fidelity Investments, Durham North Carolina
•	Analyze business requirements and technical specification documents to develop CICS updates. 
•	CICS program updates
•	 Testing of CICS programs using INTERTEST and MAUI
•	CICS WEB experience using GIFER to parse information to CICS 
Environment: JCL COBOL, TSO/ISPF, DB2, SQL, VSAM, CICS, MAUI, Intertest

positions.title: Mainframe Programmer
positions.description:
•Analyzed business requirements and technical specification documents to develop CICS VT 
•Unloaded existing data from VSAM file into a flat file
•Converted the data to the DB2 format
•Testing of CICS programs to ensure the data conversion worked
•	Used File-Aid and QMF to validate data
•	Program Documentation 
•	Used DB2 to set up DB2 panels for processing 
Environment: JCL COBOL, TSO/ISPF, DB2, SQL, VSAM, CICS VT

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
•Analyst of system flow to determine which copybooks and programs could be archived . 
•Wrote Cobol Db2 program for the ICI system that created a file for Comerica Securities for ICIA accounts.
•Created DB2 files by accessing data from VSAM flat files

positions.title: Sr. Consultant
positions.description:
On assignment at  Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan

Worked with a team of 4 under QA environment
•Analyzed business requirements and technical specification documents to develop the test cases and scenarios. 
•Worked with business and technical resources to analyze problems encountered in testing and determining changes required to correct problems
•Submission of  Test JCL.
•Identify and gather test data.
•Logged test results/defects and perform test results analysis.
•Verification of test results.
Environment: IBM 3270 Series, MVS, JCL COBOL, COBOLII, TSO/ISPF, DB2, ENDEVOR, SQL, FILEAID, EXPEDITOR, EXCEL
